
# SMART-SEQ DATASETS for SET-UP

### 1. Lun 416B Smart-seq2 dataset
- ArrayExpress / BioStudies accession: E-MTAB-5522
- ENA secondary accession: ERP022251
- ENA run range: ERR1897928–ERR1898311


```r
library(scRNAseq)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

sce <- LunSpikeInData(which = "416b")

sce
colData(sce)
rowData(sce)
```


### 2. Tabula Muris / Tabula Muris Senis Smart-seq2
- PRJNA544748 /GSE132040
- 공식 웹사이트 기반 아마존 클라우드 데이터 다운로드
- amazon s3 : aws s3 ls --no-sign-request s3://czb-tabula-muris-senis/
- 3 month, Liver(96), Pancreas(96), Lung(48+48) 를 셋업 데이터세트로 사용 (mouse-id : 3_10_M, 3_11_M)
- https://github.com/czbiohub-sf/tabula-muris

```r
BiocManager::install("TabulaMurisSenisData")
library(TabulaMurisSenisData)
```

```r
    library(data.table)
    library(plyr)
    library(dplyr)
    library(Hmisc)

    meta_info_dir <- "/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets/002.Tabula-Muris-Senis-SmartSeq2/meta"
    # meta-info
    meta_sinfo <- read.csv(sprintf("%s/tabula-muris-senis-full-metadata.csv", meta_info_dir))
    # smartseq-data info
    files_smart <- read.csv(sprintf("%s/plate_seq_3_month_fastqs_read1_read2.csv", meta_info_dir))
    sinfo_smart <- read.csv(sprintf("%s/plate_seq_3_month_fastqs_annotated.csv", meta_info_dir))
    # bulk-rnaseq-data info
    sinfo_bulk <- read.csv(sprintf("%s/MACA_Bulk_metadata.csv", meta_info_dir))
    files_bulk <- read.delim(sprintf("%s/Bulk-RNAseq-File-List.txt", meta_info_dir))

    set.seed(42)
    sample_balanced_celltypes <- function(df, n_total) {
        df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(cell_ontology_class)) %>% mutate(.row_id_for_sampling = row_number())
        if (nrow(df) == 0) { return(df) }
        celltypes <- unique(df$cell_ontology_class)
        per_type  <- max(1, floor(n_total / length(celltypes)))
        picked <- df %>% group_by(cell_ontology_class) %>% group_modify(~ {
            n_take <- min(per_type, nrow(.x))
            slice_sample(.x, n = n_take)
        }) %>% ungroup()
        if (nrow(picked) < n_total) {
            remaining <- df %>% filter(!.row_id_for_sampling %in% picked$.row_id_for_sampling)
            n_extra   <- min(n_total - nrow(picked), nrow(remaining))
            if (n_extra > 0) {
                extra  <- remaining %>% slice_sample(n = n_extra)
                picked <- bind_rows(picked, extra)
            }
        }
        if (nrow(picked) > n_total) { picked <- picked %>% slice_sample(n = n_total) }
        picked %>% select(-.row_id_for_sampling)
    }

    ## 10X Tissue-MouseID
    # 3-M-8    Spleen 2493 -> 96
    # 3-M-7/8  Lung   1662 -> 96
    # 3-M-8/9  Liver  460  -> 96

    ## FACS Tissue-MouseID
    # 3_10_M lung 48 
    # 3_11_M lung 48
    # 3_10_M spleen 48
    # 3_11_M spleen 48
    # 3_11_M liver 96 
 
    ## scRNAseq
    dinfo_10x <- bind_rows(
        meta_sinfo %>% filter( mouse.id == "3-M-8", tissue == "Spleen", method == "droplet") %>% sample_balanced_celltypes(96),
        meta_sinfo %>% filter( mouse.id == "3-M-7/8", tissue == "Lung", method == "droplet") %>% sample_balanced_celltypes(96),
        meta_sinfo %>% filter( mouse.id == "3-M-8/9", tissue == "Liver", method == "droplet") %>% sample_balanced_celltypes(96)
    )
    dinfo_10x$fastq_batch <- sapply( dinfo_10x$cell, function(y) paste0(unlist(strsplit(y, "_"))[1:3], collapse="_") )
    amazon_path_10x <- "s3://czb-tabula-muris-senis/10x/FASTQs"
    dinfo_10x$amazon_fastq_dir <- paste0(amazon_path_10x, "/", dinfo_10x$fastq_batch, "/")
    dinfo_10x <- as.data.frame(dinfo_10x)

    ## SmartSeq2
    dinfo_facs <- bind_rows(
        sinfo_smart %>% filter( mouse.id == "3_10_M", tissue == "Lung" ) %>% sample_balanced_celltypes(48),
        sinfo_smart %>% filter( mouse.id == "3_11_M", tissue == "Lung" ) %>% sample_balanced_celltypes(48),
        sinfo_smart %>% filter( mouse.id == "3_10_M", tissue == "Spleen" ) %>% sample_balanced_celltypes(48),
        sinfo_smart %>% filter( mouse.id == "3_11_M", tissue == "Spleen" ) %>% sample_balanced_celltypes(48),
        sinfo_smart %>% filter( mouse.id == "3_11_M", tissue == "Liver"  ) %>% sample_balanced_celltypes(96)
    ) %>% mutate( GCX_ID=paste0("GCX_TMS_SmartSeq2_", formatC(1:nrow(.), digits=0, flag='0', width=3)) ) %>% as.data.frame()
    
    ## BulkRNAseq
    dinfo_bulk <- sinfo_bulk %>% filter( Organ %in% c("Lung","Liver","Spleen") ) %>% filter( Sex=="m", Age == '3')
    amazon_path_bulk <- "s3://czb-tabula-muris-senis/Bulk/190214_A00111_0269_AHH3J3DSXX__190214_A00111_0270_BHHMFWDSXX/fastqs/"
    for( j in 1:nrow(dinfo_bulk) ){
        fqfiles <- files_bulk[grepl(dinfo_bulk$Sample_Name[j], files_bulk[,1]), 1]
        fqR1 <- fqfiles[grepl("R1", fqfiles)]
        fqR2 <- fqfiles[grepl("R2", fqfiles)]
        dinfo_bulk[j, "R1"] =  paste0(amazon_path_bulk, fqR1)
        dinfo_bulk[j, "R2"] =  paste0(amazon_path_bulk, fqR2)
    }
    dinfo_bulk <- dinfo_bulk %>% mutate( GCX_ID = paste0("GCX_TMS_BulkRNAseq_", Organ, "_0", 1:4) )

    saveRDS(
        list(BulkRNAseq=dinfo_bulk, SmartSeq2=dinfo_facs, scRNAseq=dinfo_10x),
        file="/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets/002.Tabula-Muris-Senis-SmartSeq2/meta/GCX.Pipeline.Setup.Dataset.Info.RDS"
    )

    #### DOWNLOAD
    dinfo_list <- readRDS("/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets/002.Tabula-Muris-Senis-SmartSeq2/meta/GCX.Pipeline.Setup.Dataset.Info.RDS")
    data_dir   <- "/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets/002.Tabula-Muris-Senis-SmartSeq2/fastq"

    ## BulkRNAseq
    dinfo_bulk <- dinfo_list$BulkRNAseq
    fastq_dir_bulk <- sprintf("%s/BulkRNAseq", data_dir )
    system(sprintf("mkdir -p %s", fastq_dir_bulk))  
    for( i in 1:nrow(dinfo_bulk) ){
        cmd_r1 <- sprintf("aws s3 cp --no-sign-request %s %s/%s_R1.fastq.gz", dinfo_bulk[i, "R1"], fastq_dir_bulk, dinfo_bulk[i, "GCX_ID"])
        cmd_r2 <- sprintf("aws s3 cp --no-sign-request %s %s/%s_R2.fastq.gz", dinfo_bulk[i, "R2"], fastq_dir_bulk, dinfo_bulk[i, "GCX_ID"])
        system(cmd_r1)
        system(cmd_r2)
    }

    ## scRNAseq
    dinfo_10x <-dinfo_list$scRNAseq
    fastq_dir_10x <- sprintf("%s/scRNAseq", data_dir )
    system(sprintf("mkdir -p %s", fastq_dir_10x))  
    BatchID="10X_P4_7"
    amazon_path_10x <- "s3://czb-tabula-muris-senis/10x/FASTQs"
    for( BatchID in c("10X_P4_7","10X_P8_13","10X_P4_2"))
    {
        cmd_10x <- sprintf("aws s3 cp --recursive --no-sign-request %s/%s/ %s/%s/", amazon_path_10x, BatchID, fastq_dir_10x, BatchID)
        system(cmd_10x)
    }
    # <bash code>
    # for BatchID in "10X_P8_13" "10X_P4_2"
    # do
    #     aws s3 cp --recursive --no-sign-request s3://czb-tabula-muris-senis/10x/FASTQs/${BatchID}/ /data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets/002.Tabula-Muris-Senis-SmartSeq2/fastq/scRNAseq/${BatchID}/
    # done

    ## SmartSeq2
    dinfo_facs <- dinfo_list$SmartSeq2
    fastq_dir_facs <- sprintf("%s/SmartSeq2", data_dir )
    system(sprintf("mkdir -p %s", fastq_dir_facs)) 
    setwd(fastq_dir_facs) 
    for( i in 1:nrow(dinfo_facs) ){
        cmd_r1 <- sprintf("aws s3 cp --no-sign-request %s %s/%s", gsub("maca","tabula-muris-senis", dinfo_facs[i, "R1"]), fastq_dir_facs, tail(unlist(strsplit(dinfo_facs[i, "R1"], "/")), 1))
        cmd_r2 <- sprintf("aws s3 cp --no-sign-request %s %s/%s", gsub("maca","tabula-muris-senis", dinfo_facs[i, "R2"]), fastq_dir_facs, tail(unlist(strsplit(dinfo_facs[i, "R2"], "/")), 1))
        system(cmd_r1)
        system(cmd_r2)
        system(sprintf("ln -Tsf %s %s_R1.fastq.gz", tail(unlist(strsplit(dinfo_facs[i, "R1"], "/")), 1), dinfo_facs[i, "GCX_ID"]))
        system(sprintf("ln -Tsf %s %s_R2.fastq.gz", tail(unlist(strsplit(dinfo_facs[i, "R2"], "/")), 1), dinfo_facs[i, "GCX_ID"]))
    }

    ## SampleList For Processing
    process_config_bulk <- data.frame(
        BaseDir        = "/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets",
        BatchID        = "002.Tabula-Muris-Senis",
        SeqPlatform    = "BulkRNAseq",
        SeqID          = dinfo_bulk$GCX_ID,
        GenomeAssembly = "mm39"
    )

    process_config_scrnaseq <- data.frame(
        BaseDir        = "/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets",
        BatchID        = "002.Tabula-Muris-Senis",
        SeqPlatform    = "scRNAseq",
        SampleID       = unique(dinfo_10x$fastq_batch),
        GenomeAssembly = "mm39"
    )

    process_config_smartseq <- data.frame(
        BaseDir        = "/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets",
        BatchID        = "002.Tabula-Muris-Senis",
        SeqPlatform    = "SmartSeq2",
        SeqID          = dinfo_facs$GCX_ID,
        GenomeAssembly = "mm39_ercc.plus"
    )
    
    write.table( process_config_bulk, 
        "/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets/002.Tabula-Muris-Senis/meta/processing.BulkRNAseq.list",
        quote=F, col.names=T, row.name=F, sep=" "
    )
    write.table( process_config_scrnaseq, 
        "/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets/002.Tabula-Muris-Senis/meta/processing.scRNAseq.list",
        quote=F, col.names=T, row.name=F, sep=" "
    )
    write.table( process_config_smartseq, 
        "/data/scRNAseq/02.Public-Datasets/002.Tabula-Muris-Senis/meta/processing.SmartSeq2.list",
        quote=F, col.names=T, row.name=F, sep=" "
    )




```
